cases.get.title: Intermittent Teams sign-in failures for about 60 users at the Rotterdam site

resolution.summary: After a TLS inspection policy update, one of three web proxy nodes became overloaded and timed out for a share of requests to Microsoft sign-in hosts, causing intermittent Teams sign-in failures for Rotterdam users routed through that node.
resolution.rootCause: After a TLS inspection policy update at 21:40 UTC on 2026-04-13 proxy-rtm-2 was saturated (97 percent CPU) and timed out for about one in three requests to Microsoft sign-in hosts. PAC rotation across three nodes made sign-in intermittent.
resolution.workaround: proxy-rtm-2 removed from PAC rotation at 11:35 UTC on 2026-04-14.
resolution.permanentFix: TLS inspection bypass for Microsoft 365 endpoints deployed at 15:00 UTC on 2026-04-14 and a proxy capacity review under change control.

validation.method: 100 requests per proxy node after the change plus 4 hours of client sign-in telemetry (0 failures) and customer confirmation.
